answer: A payout is split and hence 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The sable schedule is applied in violet and crystal shows each instalment. A hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4020 identities would post 560 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
